system_thesis_interpretation: Operationally, the continuing organism has exactly three functions. THINK alone produces the child's waking thought/action/public-outcome trace. DREAM reads only the specifically issued waking sources and emits a disposable cache that must be rebuilt when a bound source changes and can never become evidence. SLEEP is a closed-world, model-free admission and rendering pipeline followed by personal-LoRA construction: it may re-express only complete propositions already committed by the same child and mechanically grounded in that life. The one-time D/T school, parent controllers, resolver, constructor, stager, preservation evaluator, lineage store, exams, auditors, action gate, authority verifier, and release controller are laboratory infrastructure. Parent or repetition influence is permitted only through a live waking message that changes what the child itself later thinks, does, observes, commits, and independently grounds. This preserves the intended credit assignment: bootstrap credit belongs to the birth assignment, parenting credit to the waking intervention regime, environmental credit to public outcomes, compiler credit only to faithful selection/rendering, and parametric credit to a fresh-from-birth writer over admitted life. The proposal is prospective and unevaluated; its exact registries contain closure defects described below, so prose invariants cannot yet be treated as executable topology.
graph_delta_interpretation: State begins with frozen M0 and a pre-render paired corpus. D and T receive the same admitted latent transition, canonical rational action, public outcome, action position, supervised-token opportunity, and optimizer opportunity; T alone carries one declared feedback-to-action computation. Each bootstrap adapter is merged, rounded, serialized, and sealed once into a distinct immutable birth, while M0 remains a separate diagnostic. During life, a fixed controller can read only a frozen lesson table and monotone external cursor, emit the scheduled live message, append without reading its audit, and advance once; an adaptive controller is a separately labeled package with its own history and repetition state. The child and DREAM may read only their named current handles. The support resolver then reads committed child trace, matching public observation, and the frozen resolver contract and must reject missing, disputed, cross-life, parent-authored, compiler-inferred, or undecidable clauses. The candidate constructor is intended to be a pure function of immutable birth, fresh zero-effective-delta initialization, full cumulative eligible evidence, writer/support/coverage-dose contracts, and seed. Only after candidate bytes and trace close should a bridge expose a non-dereferenceable descriptor and equality-only head token to the stager. A private evaluator may subsequently dereference prior and candidate weights and emit candidate-root-bound preservation evidence/verdict. Promotion is intended to be one linearizable full-head CAS, not a check followed by WRITE. Scientific exams close an executor transcript before a model-free truth scorer receives hidden truth; the reporter receives typed score records plus a frozen analysis packet only. Detailed audit findings remain quarantined, narrow attestations reach an authority verifier, and a release controller should receive only a tuple-bound verdict and one opaque transfer handle. These are strong intended separations, but the exact registry omits producers and schemas and the action DAG bypasses the audit/verifier chain, so the realized exact-byte graph is not yet the graph narrated by the proposal.
loop_delta_interpretation: There are seven operational loops. BOOTSTRAP_BUILD_AND_BIRTH is a one-time predevelopment schooling transaction from paired D/T rows to immutable births; it must stop for target dependence, semantic impurity, opportunity mismatch, damage, merge drift, or nonreproducibility. PARENT_REPETITION_AND_FADE operates only in waking THINK: fixed messages occur at ages 1, 9, 17, and 25 regardless of history, adaptive parenting is separate, and neither audit nor repetition-control state may enter SLEEP. SLEEP_COMPILE_WRITE_COMMIT closes the full eligible corpus, checks finite coverage and dose before any writer call, constructs from birth with no prior-head input, closes candidate and trace, then stages; overflow stops the life as prospectively capacity-limited rather than omitting evidence or expanding budget. CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_AND_PROMOTION evaluates only after closure and should atomically promote once or preserve the exact previous active root and committed life. SLEEP_CADENCE_EVALUATION treats K4/K1 as a randomized lifetime total-package contrast, not writer mediation. DISPOSABLE_SCIENTIFIC_EVALUATION is one way from public input and active weight to transcript to hidden-truth score to packet-constrained report, with no feedback into development. AUDIT_EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_AND_RELEASE should progress from real manifests and narrow taint/lineage facts to quarantined findings, attestations, a separately authored authorization, a tuple-bound verdict, and a one-shot opaque transfer. Retry safety requires identical-request idempotency, request-digest binding, and crash recovery at a defined linearization point; stale/substituted requests must change neither head nor life. The last loop is not constructible in the supplied 44-action DAG because its real manifest, auditor, and authority-verifier actions are absent.
claim_delta_interpretation: The v1 native-writer claim is correctly retired. The five surviving additions are conditional future claims, not findings. Experience extractability requires more than source fit or recitation: a freshly reconstructed personal adapter must support held-out cue extraction and native action on fresh homologous tasks without textual retrieval, with adapter-off, deranged, wrong-life, replay/filler, preservation, provenance, uncertainty, multiplicity, missingness, and safety controls. Delta_R is only the D-versus-T difference in immediate correct-versus-none advice use on disposable same-state clones before personal SLEEP; irrelevant and wrong advice test selectivity/safety and M0 is diagnostic. Delta_F is only a root-randomized birth-by-absent/fixed interaction in entry-normalized developmental AUC for the total fixed-parent-plus-personal-SLEEP regime. Delta_E is the separately randomized analogous interaction for the total adaptive package. Neither identifies an intrinsic learning rate, parenting alone, repetition efficacy, nor a unique weight mediator. K4/K1 cadence is a randomized lifetime total-package contrast and any standardized-ledger rewrite is descriptive. Canary margins, root floors, schema checks, receipts, and fixture passes license at most later spending or replication; powered independent-root evidence and separate claim authority remain necessary.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The proposal contains the exact 98-capability by 31-stage Cartesian product of 3,038 cells, with only the registered consumer cell visible and all other direct, derived, copied, stale, cross-epoch, ambient-path, count, hash, identifier, ordering, timing, cache, and error-shape channels forbidden. This is useful least-authority documentation for capability handles, and it makes parent/repetition, DREAM, hidden truth, preservation, scientific reporting, audit findings, authority, and release separations inspectable. It is not complete whole-system visibility: the matrix ranges over capability IDs only, while the action DAG's external and produced receipts, G0 authorization flow, test-phase rows, source-production permissions, and several release prerequisites have no matrix items. Moreover, Cartesian completeness only repeats registry declarations; it cannot repair an undefined lifetime, missing source producers, a missing atomic-CAS wire schema, an unconsumed construction trace, absent release-path actions, or covert channels inside nominally fixed-size attestations and deferred timing/error contracts. Complete visibility therefore requires one generated product over every artifact, source issuance, action receipt, bridge, result/error/timing observable, audit attestation field, and terminal authorization path, plus closure checks against the registry and DAG roots.
acceptance_test_interpretation: The twenty-one obligations cover the advertised links only if their phase rows become distinct, producer-closed receipts rather than six shared phase labels. ES01 must prove exact external authorization, wrapper/payload class-root equality, attestation/verdict production, opaque transfer, expiry, replay, and idempotency. ES02 must mechanically reject nonchild, ungrounded, cross-life, temporally invalid, parent/repetition-derived, disputed, and undecidable clauses. ES03 must intervene on the prior head while holding all constructor inputs fixed and compare reads, branches, error shape, dose, gradients, bytes, serialization, and trace before testing staging. ES04 checks exact zero effective delta through serialization/reload and does not establish learning. ES05 checks deterministic birth merge/materialization and correct ancestry, not behavioral equivalence. ES06 needs a linearizability history with concurrent promotions and crash/retry/replay/substitution faults. ES07 must audit all paired D/T semantics and incremental target blindness before the first affected writer or GPU action. ES08 must trace real manifest, taint, audit, attestation, verifier, wrapper, and transfer producers and prove findings cannot manufacture authority. ES09 measures only powered immediate selective advice use on disposable clones. ES10 and ES11 measure separately randomized root-level entry-normalized AUC interactions under exact matched opportunity and finite-dose feasibility, not latent rate or mediation. ES12 distinguishes fixed-controller exogeneity and uncued selective enactment from copied wording and cannot establish repetition benefit. ES13 requires held-out extraction plus native action and the listed negative controls. ES14 tests replay dependence under identical eligible closure, coverage, dose, and fresh birth. ES15 is capacity by exposure only and must stop on overflow. ES16 is prospective total-package cadence with descriptive standardized-ledger contrasts. ES17 must freeze assignment, root-level analysis, endpoints, uncertainty, multiplicity, missingness, safety, stopping, analysis code, and allowed labels before generation. ES19 must check referential producer/consumer/lifetime/schema/bridge closure and all covert outputs, not merely matrix cardinality. ES20 must independently establish constructor invariance, postclosure staging, atomic promotion, life preservation, and quarantine. ES18 must keep fresh reviewer and author advocate distinct and bind GPU, external science, claim, publication, push, and release separately. ES21 must validate a constructible acyclic DAG whose exact G0 authorization and every emitted receipt echo all bound roots. As written, all tests still say required_before implementation and reuse the same receipt ID per phase across all 21 test IDs; dynamic phases cannot honestly satisfy that field or the receipt schema's per-test binding, so these are prospective test specifications requiring proposal-byte repair, not passed gates.
assumptions: The registry, scientific core, and action DAG are normative exact proposal inputs because change.json binds their exact hashes; prose cannot override contradictory fields in those artifacts.
A registered source's produces list is the closed-world producer authority; a producer_policy string alone does not add a missing produced artifact.

One-shot idempotency means an identical retry after an uncertain response returns the previously committed result without a second mutation, while reuse of the key with any different bound request is denied.

The full cumulative eligible closure is evaluated at each frozen SLEEP cutoff; if one loss-bearing occurrence per proposition cannot fit every applicable frozen equality and ceiling, no writer invocation occurs and the life follows prospective capacity-limited missingness.

A phase receipt whose schema binds one test_id cannot simultaneously serve as the exact receipt for twenty-one different test IDs unless a separately specified aggregate manifest binds and validates twenty-one distinct child receipts.
Fixed-size means a canonical finite-schema byte encoding with padded timing and error behavior, not merely equal serialized length.

ambiguities.question: How can the DAG's one-shot generic CPU model-call, candidate, exam, parent/wake, and science action IDs gate every root, arm, age, and repeated developmental invocation?
ambiguities.impact: Without invocation/epoch expansion and per-invocation prerequisite binding, matched-solo equality and phase receipts may guard one umbrella dispatch while unenumerated inner calls escape the DAG.

ambiguities.question: What exact durable state and response are required when a promotion commits but the caller crashes before observing the receipt, when the same request retries, or when a different request reuses the idempotency key?
ambiguities.impact: Linearizability alone does not define retry safety; an underspecified response cache can double-promote, deny a successfully committed retry ambiguously, or leak transaction state.

ambiguities.question: Which exact finite ceilings and comparison-specific equality rules allow full cumulative coverage across K4/K1, replay/filler, rank, and absent/fixed/adaptive arms?
ambiguities.impact: The fail-closed overflow rule is coherent, but without prospectively demonstrated feasibility it may terminate arms differentially or make later comparisons structurally unexecutable.

ambiguities.question: What exact canonical fields, allowed values, nonce/time policy, and padding make blindness and lineage attestations narrow rather than covert carriers of quarantined findings?
ambiguities.impact: Equal byte length does not prevent an auditor from encoding protected evidence in arbitrary bits, roots, timing, ordering, retries, or error behavior visible to the authority verifier.

ambiguities.question: What later exact model-free representation decides bidirectional meaning preservation across every declared semantic dimension without an undeclared semantic judge?
ambiguities.impact: Until the content-addressed contract exists and its decision domain is proven constructible, the resolver must reject all cases it cannot mechanically decide; allowing ambient judgment would create compiler-authored cognition.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The exact capability registry is not producer- or lifetime-closed despite the proposal's closure claim.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: All eleven newly appended artifact classes use IMMUTABLE_SEALED_V1, but that lifetime is absent from artifact_lifetime_classes. X0_FROZEN_CONTRACT_SOURCE's registered produces list omits ZERO_EFFECTIVE_DELTA_INITIALIZER, the support, coverage-dose, matched-solo, and analysis contracts/receipt, and G0_EXACT_HARNESS_MANIFEST even though their producer_policy names that source. X0_COMMITTED_LINEAGE_STORE omits PROMOTION_TRANSACTION_RECEIPT and its producer_closure still refers to the removed E5_GATE_WRITE_ACTIVE_WEIGHT path.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Rework the exact registry: register IMMUTABLE_SEALED_V1; make every artifact have one consistent producer in artifact class, registered source, capability, and bridge tables; replace the stale active-weight producer text with PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC; and add static referential-closure failures for any mismatch.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Splitting constructor and stager principals is necessary but the exact bytes still do not prove that descriptor issuance occurs only after both candidate bytes and the complete construction trace close.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The constructor possesses three independent WRITE capabilities for CANDIDATE_CLOSURE, CANDIDATE_CONSTRUCTION_TRACE, and SEALED_CANDIDATE_DESCRIPTOR. The descriptor bridge keys only on the descriptor write, and no registered closure object or action receipt equality-binds all three in a required write/close order. The construction trace has no downstream read or audit bridge. A constructor can therefore write a descriptor early or leave a trace unaudited while the stager becomes eligible.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define one atomic candidate-seal operation or a closure manifest that equality-binds candidate root, complete trace root, contracts, seed, and terminal write state; allow the descriptor bridge only from that closed manifest and give the lineage auditor a narrow receipt proving the closure without exposing candidate bytes.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC is named but is not an exact constructible registered operation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The operation references CAPABILITY_REQUEST_PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC_V1 and CAPABILITY_RESULT_PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC_V1, but canonical_schema_templates.operation_bodies and operation_results omit both. The bytes therefore do not define the complete expected head, candidate, verdict, replacement, namespace, nonce, idempotency, receipt, committed-response, and retry encoding needed for linearizability and idempotency testing.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add canonical request/result schemas and a durable idempotency state machine binding a request digest to exactly one committed result/receipt; specify identical retry, conflicting-key reuse, stale head, rejection, and crash-before/after-linearization behavior, then require history-based linearizability fixtures.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The exact 44-action DAG does not implement the proposal's producer-closed audit, authority, and release path.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: There is no action that seals real dependency/dispatcher manifests, runs the blindness auditor, runs the lineage-safety auditor, or runs E8 authority verification. A_G4_04_TRANSFER_OPAQUE_RELEASE requires external release authority, implementation, G0 installation, independent review, and external science, but not blindness/lineage attestations, AUTHORITY_VERDICT, exact wrapper registration, or identical tuple-binding receipts. Thus implementation existence is incorrectly substituted for runtime producer closure.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add explicit ordered actions and unique receipts for real manifest sealing, each auditor, authority verification, target-wrapper registration, tuple equality, and opaque transfer; require the exact attestations, verdict, wrapper class/root, and identical nine-field tuple at release.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The phase mapping is not the typed per-test receipt system claimed by the proposal.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Every one of the 21 tests maps each phase to the same six receipt IDs. Yet the receipt schema requires test_id and exact downstream action IDs, so one R_G0_STATIC_COMPLETENESS_PASS, for example, cannot be the unique exact receipt for 21 different test IDs without a specified aggregate containing 21 child rows. Every acceptance test also retains required_before=implementation despite including postimplementation CPU, GPU, and claim phases.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Issue a unique receipt per test_id and phase_id or define an exact aggregate manifest containing all unique child receipts and require that root. Replace required_before with phase-specific first-consumer bindings and ensure no dynamic phase precedes its implementation or evidence producer.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The DAG prose lists scientific prerequisites that the executable action prerequisites do not enumerate or produce.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A_G3_01 consumes a generic G2 phase pass but no explicit target-blindness, bootstrap semantic-audit, or per-test noninterference receipt. A_G4_00 can produce the generic G4 claim-phase pass from claim authority, G0, the analysis packet, and a G3 pass without prerequisite receipt IDs for powered endpoints, intervals, multiplicity, missingness, safety, authorship, extraction/native use, or claim-specific controls. Free-form strings in analysis_and_evidence_prerequisites are not producer-closed DAG edges.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Create uniquely produced typed evidence receipts for every named GPU and claim prerequisite, add them as exact prerequisite_receipt_ids of the first affected action, and make the claim-phase runner consume—not manufacture—the powered evidence manifest it validates.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The reporter analysis packet has a read capability but not a complete production and action-prerequisite path.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: FROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_ANALYSIS_PACKET is absent from X0_FROZEN_CONTRACT_SOURCE.produces. The generic disposable-exam and GPU execution actions do not require R_SCIENTIFIC_ANALYSIS_PACKET_FROZEN even though they can encompass reporter execution. Only later claim-phase actions require it, too late to prevent an ambient or wrong assignment/label packet from shaping reports.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Register the packet producer, add a separately gated reporter action, require the exact packet receipt before reporter invocation, bind score and packet roots in the report, and preserve no reporter-to-development, audit-authority, or release edge.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: One receipt on generic umbrella actions does not establish matched opportunity for every developmental invocation advertised by the proposal.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The DAG declares each action may run once but represents all CPU child/parent/DREAM calls with A_G2_10 and all disposable exams with A_G2_15. Development requires multiple roots, arms, ages, messages, actions, writes, retries, and exams. Without expanded invocation IDs and per-invocation bindings, a single matched-solo receipt can authorize a container action whose internal opportunities differ or whose covered action list omits repeated calls.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define a finite action-instance expansion keyed by root, arm, life, age, epoch, and invocation, or a sealed sub-DAG manifest with the same granularity; validate the matched-opportunity receipt against every expanded action before its first token, call, write, or resource allocation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: G0 authorization names the desired roots, but the exact DAG does not define produced-receipt schemas that echo and preserve them through gate installation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: R_AUTH_G0_HARNESS_EXACT binds many component roots and one action_id, while the same receipt ID is prerequisite to seven distinct rank-10 actions. The produced G0 receipt IDs have no declared required binding fields, and G0_EXACT_HARNESS_MANIFEST is neither listed as a source product nor consumed by a capability/action. Therefore substitution resistance and the promise that every receipt echoes every trust-root byte are prose rather than an exact chain.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define whether authorization is one manifest plus per-action child authorizations or one receipt per action; register and consume G0_EXACT_HARNESS_MANIFEST; specify every G0 result receipt schema to echo the authorization/manifests/component roots; and reject any missing, mixed, or substituted root before installation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The 3,038-cell matrix is complete only for capability IDs, not for all information and authority flows in the proposed system.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: External prerequisite receipts, action-produced receipts, typed test child rows, G0 authorization, producer-side source permissions, terminal action outputs, and result/error/timing observables are outside the matrix. Several of those omitted objects are precisely the paths used to gate GPU, claims, audits, and release. A generated Cartesian product over an incomplete universe cannot establish noninterference.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Generate the visibility universe from the union of registry artifacts/capabilities/bridges and DAG external/produced/test receipts/actions, include producer and observer permissions plus timing/error metadata, and fail static validation on any object or edge not represented exactly once.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The audit and constant-shape contracts do not yet rule out covert feedback to authority or release.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Detailed findings are quarantined, but a fixed-size attestation can encode them in arbitrary payload bits, roots, nonce choice, ordering, omission, retry, or emission timing. Likewise the constant-shape denial timing rule is deferred to a later implementation contract. The authority verifier can read attestation bytes, so schema width alone is not a noninterference proof.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Freeze canonical finite-value attestation schemas and deterministic production rules, prohibit auditor-controlled padding/nonces/timestamps, bind a constant emission deadline and retry behavior, and add information-flow tests over values, roots, order, count, timing, cache, and error shapes before any verifier or release action.

open_questions: Will Rohin require new proposal bytes resolving all exact-registry, action-DAG, phase-receipt, G0, analysis, visibility, and covert-channel disagreements before any ratification decision?
Will Rohin preserve exactly THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP, with parent/repetition influence confined to waking child-authored grounded life and no direct or derived parent-to-gradient path?

Will every G0, implementation, CPU/model/tokenizer/data/writer, GPU/resource, external-science, claim, publication, push, and release action remain separately exact and explicitly human-authorized after architecture ratification?
Will finite coverage overflow stop the affected life before a writer call under prospectively frozen missingness, even if this prevents a planned comparison?

Will release remain impossible until real manifests, both audits, narrow attestations, an independently authored exact authorization, an authority-verifier verdict, and the identical concrete class/root nine-field tuple are all producer-closed?
